'''Nirama's public asteroid''' was the largest asteroid within the [[Cularin asteroid belt]], being over 400 kilometers in diameter. [[Nirama]] had a large base on the asteroid, which he had inherited from [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Riboga and Nirama both used the base to meet with their employees within the [[Organization]], especially the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] of the [[Smugglers' Confederation]]. Riboga had had a private asteroid for his own use, which Nirama also gained.<ref name="LFC" />

The smugglers nevertheless preferred not to meet their boss in his asteroid, as he could easily take their ships there. They rather chose a meeting place such as the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], or the use of proxies to avoid a real meeting.<ref name="LFC" />

Much of the Organization's operations were based here, and many of its members resided at least part time on the asteroid. The upper part of the asteroid held the docking bays, the area where Nirama dwelt and met with people, and cell blocks. The inner part of the asteroid was essentially its own city, with independently run businesses such as the [[Hutt's Tail]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], even having failed and abandoned businesses such as [[Mokada's Place]]. The base was divided into an unknown number of sectors, with [[Red Sector]] being an infamous, troublesome one.<ref name="TW" />

[[The Cell]], a rival faction of the Organization trying to oust Nirama, managed to grasp control of part of his public asteroid.<ref name="TW" /> Nirama then used his public asteroid as his main headquarters while trying to find Cell members in other places, to question them.<ref name="MW">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: MidWorld}}</ref>

Weapons were not allowed in the inner areas of the asteroid, and it was policed by the Organization's security forces. Nirama's personal security forces had higher authority, and were allowed to carry weapons&mdash;usually [[Stun baton/Legends|stun batons]] and [[Force pike/Legends|force pikes]]. Nirama's security detail wore uniforms of silver and black, with rank being denoted by red bars on their shoulders.<ref name="TW" />
